title: Znikomek
identity: Martyna Kosecka, Znikomek (2010), unaccompanied alto saxophone, c. 5 minutes. The composer’s current work list gives the 3 December 2010 premiere at the Music Academy in Kraków by Dawid Pliskowski and links to Donemus. The Donemus D16273 product page identifies the edition; its public two-page preview contains explanatory notes and first-performance metadata, while the eight-page score is purchasable as a separate download.

evidence.claim: Composer’s current list identifies Znikomek for alto saxophone (2010), duration 5 minutes, and a 3 December 2010 premiere at the Music Academy in Kraków by Dawid Pliskowski; it links the score and SoundCloud recording.

Donemus product D16273 identifies Znikomek for alto saxophone, 2010. The opened product page offers an eight-page score as a paid download; its public two-page preview contains an explanatory-symbol key and first-performance/program note, not score notation.
evidence.source_name: Donemus publisher product page and public preview

evidence.claim: Donemus preview key explains signs for flexible speeding/slowing, rapid sound bursts, a forceful crack-like attack, slap tongue, whole-tone trills, quarter-tone bends, a roar/flutter effect, highest possible sound, jazz slide, and overblowing. These are technique definitions; the notation passages using them were not visible in the public preview.
SoundCloud page identifies the posted track as Znikomek (2010) for alto saxophone, played by Dawid Pliskowski, and repeats the premiere information. Audio was not auditioned.

review_focus: The score’s explanatory key documents slap tongue, whole-tone trills, quarter-tone bending, crack-like attacks, flutter/roar effects, jazz slide and overblowing. These indicate a broad extended-technique vocabulary, but the accessible preview does not show the notation, frequency, sequence, or register of those effects.
collection_flag: Original unaccompanied alto-saxophone work premiered by the named soloist per the composer’s documentation; not a transcription.

listening.description: Composer-linked performance recording by Dawid Pliskowski.
listening.verification: Track title, saxophonist, and first-performance metadata verified on opened SoundCloud page; audio not auditioned.

score_links.description: Publisher product page with two-page public explanatory preview; the full eight-page downloadable score is paid. No notation page was available to inspect.

gaps: Public preview contains no notation; actual pitch range, technique frequency, temporal demands, and score layout remain unverified.
Performance link was verified, but audio was not auditioned.
